authority: A RECORD OF WHAT EXISTS, not evidence the study system consumes. Nothing here is governed: every asset below lives on an unmerged research ref and is classified RESEARCH_ONLY at source. The historical_written_qi socket in written_evidence_horizon.json is deliberately untouched by this file.

headline.verdict: DISCOVERED_AND_PRESERVED_BUT_NOT_INGESTED. The 1999-2005 DGS archive is inventoried, hashed and re-obtainable, but not one of its questions has been turned into an occurrence record. Every occurrence and every family currently held begins in 2021-02 or later, so the QI-v2 layer does not yet extend the evidence horizon backwards at all.
headline.extends_horizon_backwards_means: an occurrence earlier than 2021, the earliest written evidence MIW holds in any band. Reaching into the 2021-2023 wording-only band is NOT extending the horizon.

bands.note: Metadata only in repo. The PDFs/DOCs are NOT committed (public repo); they are held in a git-ignored intake store on the authoring workstation, with archive URL + sha256 as the machine-independent re-fetch recipe.
Structured search over every reachable ref found nothing. Not a claim that no such papers exist.

assets.holds: 98 archived DGS objects: 80 question papers, 17 result lists, 1 sample paper
185 items of the DGS Question Bank MEO CL-I
the CURRENT six-year recurrence layer (2021 onward)

historical_paper_identity.model: An archived object is identified by its DGS archive URL plus sha256, NOT by a sitting date. A sitting date is a separate, evidenced claim with its own certainty class, and most objects cannot support one.
historical_paper_identity.rule: No fabricated dates. A year-only paper contributes to year-granularity windows only, and an undated paper contributes to no window at all.

enum.SOURCE_LIMB_CONFIRMED: label matches a printed subpart label in the paper's spec
enum.SOURCE_LIMB_ASSERTED: the source paper prints limbs but the spec's subparts array does not carry labels; the limb is read off the printed stem
enum.ANALYTICAL_SEGMENT: an unlabelled sentence or clause of a single-limb question, isolated by MIW for comparison only - the paper prints no such division
enum.AUTHORING_SCAFFOLD: an MIW authoring construct (framing/intro/main/closing/head N/dN). NEVER a recurrence key.
enum.WHOLE_QUESTION: no limb; the whole question is the unit

limb_model.rule: Recurrence is observed at LIMB level. Collapsing a multi-limb question into one event under-counts.

source_provenance.why_three_axes: A family may correctly read HIGH / NONE / HIGH: the recurrence is certain, the historical date is unproven, the source is sound. One blended confidence field hid exactly that case and was removed in QI-v2 phase 2.
source_provenance.raw_wording_rule: raw_stem preserves the source exactly and is never modernised.
source_provenance.research_to_governed: Nothing crosses from RESEARCH_ONLY to governed without an explicit adoption step. This inventory is not that step.

family_join.method: family -> its occurrence question_ids -> study_mappings.json topic_id. The QI-v2 topic string is recorded but never used to classify.

QP2608-Q4.topic_effect: NONE -- both families join to D02 through their own occurrence question ids, so the join is unambiguous at topic level and always was.
QP2608-Q4.roadmap_effect: NONE -- no study_priority component reads family membership, and the historical socket is still NOT_STARTED.

FAMILY-EM-0004.reason: Tracks the WARRANTIES limb across five sittings (2021-02, 2022-02, 2023-12, 2026-06, 2026-08). Its own limb stem is the single word 'Warranties', UNSCOREABLE_SHORT_STEM, and it inherits classification from the parent question.

FAMILY-EM-0007.reason: Tracks the whole four-limb question against official bank ancestor BANK-072 (containment 0.93 forward / 1.00 reverse). One proven sitting, no bank-level date.

evidence: QUESTION_FAMILIES.json FAMILY-EM-0007.relationship_to_family_em_0004 states the separation is deliberate and that collapsing them would let the limb's five sittings appear to evidence the whole question.

QUESTION_OCCURRENCES.jsonl holds OCC-2026-08-Q4 (limb_kind WHOLE_QUESTION, 16 marks) and OCC-2026-08-Q4B (limb_kind SOURCE_LIMB_CONFIRMED, limb (b), 4 marks) as two distinct records against the same question_id.
QP2608-Q4.candidate_facing_rule: Never tell a candidate 'Q4 is a five-time repeat'. Five sittings belong to limb (b) only -- 4 of 16 marks. Limbs (a), (c) and (d) have an official ancestor but ONE proven sitting.

QP2608-Q8.topic_effect: NONE -- both families join to D03.

FAMILY-EM-0003.reason: Tracks limb (b) across 2021-03, 2022-04, 2025-12 and 2026-08. EXACT_REPEAT of official bank item BANK-054. Answer donor: QP2512-Q4.

FAMILY-EM-0005.reason: Tracks limb (a) only. Absorbs BANK-105 whole (reverse containment 0.96) and extends it with a PSC-failure scenario, so SAME_CORE_ASK, not a verbatim repeat. publication_status RESEARCH_HYPOTHESIS.

evidence: The two families attach to two different occurrence records with different limb_labels: OCC-2026-08-Q8B (limb (b), 6 marks) and OCC-2026-08-Q8A (limb (a), 10 marks). They share no text.
FAMILY-EM-0005.product_warning already states that Q8(a) and Q8(b) belong to DIFFERENT families with different strength and that any candidate-facing statement about 'Q8' must be limb-level.
QP2608-Q8.candidate_facing_rule: Never tell a candidate 'Q8 is a repeat'. The repeat is limb (b), 6 marks. Limb (a) is 10 marks, is the larger half, and has one sitting.

family_join.multi_family_rule: A question in more than one family is not a defect by itself. Recurrence is observed at LIMB level, so a multi-limb question can legitimately sit in one family per limb, or in a limb family and its whole-question family at once. Every entry above is hand-adjudicated in tools/study/qi_family_adjudications.json and the build fails closed on an unadjudicated one.

roadmap_impact_preview.why: Nothing to weight. Zero historical occurrences are ingested, and every family held sits inside the band the roadmap already counts, so adopting them today would add no evidence the spine does not already have.
roadmap_impact_preview.note: per_topic_if_adopted is a PREVIEW of families only. It is not a proposal, and no study_priority component is added by this file.
